headline: Discussed commission structure and postponed Economic Development Strategic Plan review to a future meeting.
summary: The meeting covered a council liaison update, an Inclusion & Belonging Commission update, and commission structure. The group agreed with Alternative B but was concerned that things might be swept aside if combined commissions met only quarterly. The Economic Development Strategic Plan review was postponed to a future meeting.

Postponed discussion of the Economic Development Strategic Plan to a future meeting.

9/15/2026 - Minutes
Call to Order
Members Present: Daniel Harris, Autumn Crabtree, Cait Hoffman, Jen Berger
City Staff Present: Angelia Aldieri, Elsie Goodrich
Guests Present:
Call to Order by: Cait Hoffman
Meeting Start Time: 6:02
Minutes Recorded by: Autumn Crabtree
Public Comment
No members of the public present.
Approve Previous Meeting Minutes
Motion by: Autumn Crabtree
Second: Daniel Harris
Decision: Approved
City Council Liaison Update
Councilor Goodrich thanked the commission for moving last week's meeting due to labor day. 
She updated the commission on the non-union longevity bonus pay policy, supplemental training 
balance, substantive discussion on the board, committees, and commission structure. 
Inclusion & Belonging Commission Update
Jen Berger reported that the commission has not met. They are short a commissioner so have 
not had a commissioner. Friendship festival on August 30th was ahuge success with high 
attendance and community building. 
Discussion: Commission Structure
Councilor Goodrich explained the intention of this discussion and the substance of the city 
council discussion. The commission went through the questions outlined on the memo by 
Deputy Mayor Oakleaf. The commission agreed that the intent of the commissions is to add 
additional skillsets to City issues and for a wider range of residents to provide outside feedback 
on the city. Regarding what is working well, the commission said that it is fulfilling to see results, 
the commissioners are able to become more informed citizens, and the commissioners are 
able to provide new ideas to the City. Sometimes it can be difficult as there is not always a full 
agenda and the meetings don’t always feel intentional, which leads to a lack of meaning and 
engagement. The commission discussed the Alternative B proposed in the memo and how that 
could lead to more on the agenda and greater engagement. The commission discussed that 
this process is collaborative with City Council and the City governance, as we are trying to figure 
out how to serve each other. They discussed how the commissions could be involved outside of 
monthly meetings, such as mandatory attendance at city events or attendance at City Council 
meetings to report on the discussions the committee is having. The commissioners agreed that 
success is shown in concrete examples of projects they worked on being enacted and also 
becoming more connected to the community. Ultimately, the commission agreed with 
Alternative B but was concerned that things might be swept aside if the combined commissions 
only met quarterly. There was discussion of combining some combination of the commissions 
and meeting every other month.
Discussion: Review Economic Development Strategic Plan
The commission agreed that it is difficult to provide substantive feedback on the Strategic Plan 
due to a lack of information on what objectives have been met or are being currently worked on 
and that more direction would be helpful. Finance Director Aldieri informed the commission that 
the lack of a Community Development director makes it difficult for many of the more concrete 
items to be achieved. The commission agreed to postpone the discussion to a future meeting.
Other Business
There was no other business.
Adjourn
Motion by: Autumn Crabtree
Second: Daniel Harris Meeting
End Time: 6:54
